protocol.label: 合成工程演练；不是现场验证或最优性证明
protocol.comparison_primary: preview minus simple total uncontained m3; lower is better
protocol.simple_method: urgency reservation + best one-coordinate correction or one pair swap, including current rates
protocol.preview_method: simple action + 8 parameterized rule seeds + maximum rates + one local neighborhood of simple
protocol.stopping_policy: run every case to tick64; retain terminal storage and transit
protocol.replay_policy: three arms start from deep-copied identical configuration and share exogenous event schedule
protocol.decision_timing: decision precedes next cell; newly injected cell events are observable at its end
protocol.retention_policy: all cases, ties, losses, compute cost and traces retained; no outcome-based selection
protocol.revision_policy: no controller tuning after this frozen matrix is run; corrections require explicit new version
limitations: 公开工程结构启发的合成参数，非现场实测。
不核算污染物反应、处置费用、真人操作效率或外运。
本对照限定排量协调；所有方案保持生产安排不变，避免用减产获得虚假优势。
候选选择含强规则并不保证实际长期更优；预测假定当前条件持续。
只比较此规则族，不声称超越所有商业控制器或全局最优。

configuration.name: none / easy
assumptions: 合成工程演练：所有数值均为设计输入，非现场实测。
固定接纳路线；仅核算水量，不计算污染物反应或出水质量。
每15分钟按均匀流量结算；池内并行进出，不能证明步内峰值安全。
预处理后固定滞留/输送时间，排量按5 m³/h档位调整。
20:00结束已知产水计划，随后4小时继续排送；末端库存和在途均保留。
